introHtml: Foam buttons, stickers, and patches offer a soft, lightweight feel that stands out from traditional paper or fabric options. The raised foam texture adds depth and durability, making them ideal for trade shows, promotional giveaways, or employee recognition. Choose vibrant CMYK printing or spot colors for bold logos and messages that won't peel or fade. Perfect for safety managers needing non-scratch badges or marketing directors wanting tactile brand swag.
